utility.zh: 公用事業（水、電、瓦斯）；（utilities）水電費

ex.en: The utility bill was higher this month.
ex.zh: 這個月的水電帳單比較高。

ex.en: This utility can help you recover deleted files.
ex.zh: 這個工具程式可以幫你救回刪除的檔案。

ex.en: The new app has little practical utility.
ex.zh: 這個新 app 沒什麼實用價值。

ex.en: Tom utilized some wooden chests as chairs.
ex.zh: 湯姆拿幾個木箱當椅子用。

ex.en: We need to utilize our resources more efficiently.
ex.zh: 我們需要更有效率地運用資源。

ex.en: The new system is fully utilized by all departments.
ex.zh: 各部門都充分使用新系統。

ex.en: We need to improve the utilization of our resources.
ex.zh: 我們需要提升資源的利用率。

ex.en: Machine utilization rose to 90 percent this quarter.
ex.zh: 本季機器使用率提高到九成。
這孩子說出的第一句話是「媽媽」。

ex.en: Each utterance was recorded for later analysis.
ex.zh: 每一句話都被錄下來供之後分析。

ex.en: She was too shocked to give utterance to her feelings.
ex.zh: 她震驚到說不出自己的感受。

ex.en: His careful utterance made the speech easy to follow.
ex.zh: 他說話字字清楚，演講很容易聽懂。

utilities.zh: 水電瓦斯（等公共事業費用）

ex.en: The rent is 15,000 a month, not including utilities.
ex.zh: 房租每月一萬五，不含水電瓦斯。

ex.en: Utilities are usually paid by the tenant.
ex.zh: 水電瓦斯費通常由房客支付。
